class.name: SfxParameterTrigger
class.brief_description: Starts or stops its [SfxEvent] from a parameter of the player.
class.description: Evaluated on the tick after [member parameter] changes, never per frame. Off while the player is [member SfxPlayer.cut].

members.member: A fire is dropped while the event still plays.
Seconds a fire waits after the last one; one sooner is dropped.
What a change of the value does.
[constant GATE]: releases the event below it (hysteresis).
[constant GATE]: starts the event at or above it. [constant CROSS]: the threshold crossed.
The parameter of the player it watches.
[constant GATE]: where the event starts when its gate opens again after the player was cut - past its opening.
[constant STEP]: the step whose change fires. [constant EVERY]: the travel between fires.

constants.constant: Plays while the value is on, with hysteresis between [member on_threshold] and [member off_threshold].
One-shot when the value crosses [member on_threshold].
One-shot every [member step] units the value travels (a distance counter: a rail joint each rail length).
